RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
[b]Recognizing[/b] that in the early days of this council, there was no concrete agreement on what constituted a commendable action,
[b]Understanding[/b] that some nations benefited from this lack of agreement and received recognition from this council for reasons now seen as undeserving,
[b]Arguing[/b] that The Cat-Tribe is one such nation whose commendation, SC#46, does not sufficiently capture the worthiness of its nominee,
[b]Noting[/b] that even at the time of The Cat-Tribe’s commendation, the accomplishments SC#46 reports of that fondly-remembered nation were overshadowed by those of its contemporaries,
[b]Determining[/b] that the commendation of The Cat-Tribe was based on two factors: the passage of the Legacy General Assembly (LGA) resolution “Reduction of Abortion Act”, and the award-winning skill and civility with which the diplomats and ambassadors of The Cat-Tribe conducted themselves in debate,
[b]Maintaining[/b] that the authoring of a single LGA resolution, no matter how fraught the topic, was never worthy of a commendation, citing SC#10, passed a year and a half before SC#46, which recognizes its nominee for, among other commendable acts, two authored resolutions, and SC#28, passed six months before SC#46, which recognizes its nominee for authoring four LGA resolutions,
[b]Disputing[/b] the laudability of the second part of The Cat-Tribe’s accolade, by noting that the winning of awards is in and of itself not a commendable action,
[b]Further disputing[/b] the explanation for The Cat-Tribe receiving those awards, as their conduct only represents the basic standard of engaging in debate and does not represent a commendable action,
[b]Finding[/b] that merely giving advice to other delegations on the authorship of law does not add to any argument for commendation for the delegation of The Cat-Tribe,
[b]Acknowledging[/b] that The Cat-Tribe was a well-loved nation, with a number of accomplishments under its belt that SC#46 does not recognize, and believing that a better resolution recognizing the full scope of the nation’s accomplishments could be authored should the opportunity ever arise, and
[b]Wishing[/b] to scrub the legacy of SC#46's author from the Security Council’s books,
Hereby repeals SC#46 “Commend The Cat-Tribe”.
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Commend The Cat-Tribe"
